method: paired_selftest.sh <commit> <before ref> <label>: a fresh `git clone --shared` checked out at <commit>; the selftest runs first with <before ref>'s scripts/check_spec_reconciliation.py written over the checkout (HEAD unchanged, so both witness records name the same commit), then with the commit's own file; SELFTEST_WORKERS=4, TMPDIR under ~/.tmp. The host is shared with other lanes; the load average at the end of each run is recorded beside its wall.
